name: Bitcoin

key_findings: TradFi Approved (97) is BTC's strongest category -- deep, mature institutional access via ETFs, custody, and regulated venues.
Tokenomics & Supply (95) -- fixed 21M cap, predictable halving schedule, minor deduction for unmoved Satoshi-era coins.

Privacy & Confidentiality (36) -- a fully transparent UTXO ledger with no protocol-level confidentiality, and CoinJoin tooling that has thinned since major coordinators shut down. Address non-disclosure by large holders is a policy choice rather than a network property, and has been defeated in practice by chain analysis.
Raw 80.44 rounds to 80, landing exactly on the Institutional Grade floor. Roughly one point of movement in any weighted category would change the tier.

binding_cap.short_note: Capped by Deterministic Finality FAIL -- probabilistic-only PoW settlement, no deterministic finality mechanism.

key_findings: A wide divergence between the two axes, reflecting a structural mismatch between deep institutional trust and probabilistic-only settlement architecture.
The Deterministic Finality FAIL cap is calibrated at 54, one point below the Experimental threshold.
Security Posture (88) is BTC's strongest AI category -- 15+ years, zero protocol-level exploits.

watch_items: CTV (BIP 119) and OP_CAT (BIP 347) signaling windows are open but not yet activated -- would raise the Programmability Tier ceiling if adopted.
No credible near-term path to a Deterministic Finality Pass -- the FAIL cap is architectural, not a maturity gap.

Two open framework items bear directly on this chain: a pending Decentralization scale recalibration (currently 52) and an unadopted Tokenomics revision (95 toward 97-98). They push in opposite directions and should be computed together.
